title: Supported Cartier Kummer pullback in the fixed bounded-below presentation
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $F/\mathbf Q_\ell$, $n\geq0$, and $A=\mathcal O_F/\varpi_F^{n+1}$ [def-pur-finite-tate-site-comparison]. Let $z:B\hookrightarrow X$ and $z':B'\hookrightarrow X'$ be closed immersions with invertible ideal sheaves, and let $g:B'\to B$ and $v:X'\to X$ give a chosen Cartesian square. Assume $\ell$ is invertible on $X$ and $X'$. Write $c_z:z_*A_B\to A_X(1)[2]$ and $c_{z'}:z'_*A_{B'}\to A_{X'}(1)[2]$ for the specified pro-etale Cartier Kummer arrows in $D^+$ [def-pur-line-kummer-compact-images], and $\beta:v^{-1}z_*A_B\to z'_*A_{B'}$ for the canonical supported-constant exchange [def-pur-supported-constant-exchange-maps, def-pur-section-compact-source-maps]. Suppose every map $d:v^{-1}z_*A_B\to z'_*A_{B'}$ preserving the constant restriction $A_X\to z_*A_B$, under the prescribed constant pullback comparison, equals $\beta$. There exists a projection-normalized Tate sheaf pullback isomorphism $p:v^{-1}A_X(1)\cong A_{X'}(1)$ [def-pur-finite-tate-site-comparison] such that the actual derived arrows satisfy $v^{-1}(c_z)\,p[2]=\beta\,c_{z'}$, including the exact-pullback single and shift comparisons. No flatness, finiteness, base-field or section hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Extract the Cartier Kummer base-change isomorphisms and Ext equation. Identify the supported comparison by the constant restriction equation and its uniqueness. Apply Ext.hom and the exact functor realization formulas, then reflect the resulting equality through the fully faithful D+ inclusion, cancelling its single and shift comparison isomorphisms.
